task: Fix solve(text), a CSV importer for sku,qty. The input has no header. Ignore blank rows; retain valid rows in order as [sku,qty]. Report invalid 1-based record numbers in errors. SKU is nonempty after trimming; qty is an integer from 1 to 1000. A row must have exactly two fields. Quoted commas must work. Input is well-formed CSV syntax.
es: Corregir importación CSV con validación y errores por fila.
source:
def solve(text):
    return {'rows': [[a, int(b)] for a,b in (line.split(',') for line in text.splitlines())], 'errors': []}

task: Fix solve(request), which returns document content or null. Request has user and doc objects. A user may read only if authenticated is exactly true, user.tenant is a nonempty string equal to doc.tenant, and user.role is either viewer or admin. Missing fields and other roles deny. Return doc.content if allowed, otherwise None. Inputs are JSON objects with user/doc objects.
es: Corregir autorización entre organizaciones con denegación por defecto.
source:
def solve(request):
    return request['doc']['content'] if request['user'].get('authenticated') else None

task: Fix solve(events). Each event is {id: nonempty string, amount: integer cents}. Return {'total': sum, 'conflicts': ids}. Apply the first occurrence of each id once; duplicate with same amount is a no-op; duplicate with differing amount is a conflict. Report each conflicting id once, in order of first conflict. Amount can be negative.
es: Evitar contabilización duplicada y reportar conflictos.
source:
def solve(events):
    return {'total': sum(e['amount'] for e in events), 'conflicts': []}

task: Fix solve(name), a lexical archive member validator (no filesystem operations). Return true only for nonempty relative POSIX paths made of slash-separated nonempty components; reject . and .. components, backslashes, colon, NUL, leading/trailing slash and duplicate slash. Other characters including spaces and Unicode are allowed. This is lexical validation only, not a complete safe extraction implementation.
es: Validar rutas de archivos comprimidos sin acceso al sistema de archivos.
reference:
def solve(name):
    return bool(name) and not any(c in name for c in ('\\', ':', '\x00')) and all(p not in ('', '.', '..') for p in name.split('/'))

task: Fix solve(items). Return a list of batches in original order with at most 3 items per batch AND sum of item sizes <= 10. Each size is an integer. Use greedy batching: close the current batch only when the next item would exceed a limit. If any size is outside 1..10 return None, not partial batches. Empty input returns [].
es: Corregir lotes con dos límites y rechazo atómico.
source:
def solve(items):
    return [items[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(items),3)]
